title: Wisp Warden
description: A pocket roguelite: hold back waves of shadow motes with a light that fires on its own, and draft one boon of three after every wave. Targets: a bad run still reaches a draft, the median run fits a bus ride, great runs go twice as deep, and drafts vary.
tagline: Hold back the dark, then draft a boon after every wave.
controls: Arrows / WASD, or the touch joystick, to move; your light fires by itself. Tap a card (or arrows + Space) to draft.
